title: День рождения Вики и спор Нагиева  (Vika's Birthday and Nagiyev's Bet)

scenes.title: The Sun Shines Equally on Everyone
scenes.summary: Max reflects on the sun shining equally on everyone, while Nagiyev complains about running the restaurant alone and argues with a buyer about the importance of cuisine.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Culinary Bet
scenes.summary: Nagiyev bets his friend that he can personally prepare baked rabbit under almond sauce with rosemary and truffles by evening.

scenes.title: Vika's Birthday and the Wedding
scenes.summary: Max remembers it is Vika's birthday and Nastya encourages him to text her, while Kostya promises Nastya an amazing, inexpensive wedding.

scenes.title: A Deleted Number and a Pink Car
scenes.summary: Max despairs when Vika doesn't recognize his phone number, and Eva offers her car to Kostya and Nastya for 550,000 rubles.

scenes.title: Nastya's Father Against a Cheap Wedding
scenes.summary: Nastya's father criticizes the cheap café chosen for the wedding and offers to pay for a luxurious restaurant, but Nastya angrily refuses his money.

scenes.title: Six Hundred Thousand from the Father-in-Law
scenes.summary: Nastya's father gives Kostya 600,000 rubles for a proper wedding and tells Kostya to invent a believable story for how he got the money.

scenes.title: Nagiyev Asks to Be Taught to Cook
scenes.summary: Nagiyev interrupts Chef Barinov in the kitchen and demands to be taught how to cook because he made a bet.

scenes.title: The Rabbit Recipe and a Bouquet for Vika
scenes.summary: Nagiyev convinces Chef Barinov to teach him the rabbit dish by offering a bonus, and the staff presents Vika with a birthday bouquet on her last day.

scenes.title: Mixed-Up Phones and Keys
scenes.summary: Max angrily confronts Vika as she leaves, Kostya realizes he and Max mixed up their identical phones, and Max discovers Vika never deleted his number.

scenes.title: The Truth About Vika and a Cooking Lesson
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Max that Vika never slept with Nagiyev, teaches Nagiyev kitchen tricks for the rabbit, and Kostya gives Nastya a fake 100,000-ruble bonus.

scenes.title: The Stash in the Jacket and a Stove Fire
scenes.summary: Kostya stages finding money in his jacket lining and winning a bet with Senya, while Nagiyev pours too much oil onto the stove during his cooking lesson.

scenes.title: Too Much Oil and Kostya's Request
scenes.summary: Kostya still needs to explain 400,000 rubles, Nagiyev's practice rabbit dish turns out inedible from too much oil and spice, and Kostya asks Nagiyev for help.

scenes.title: A Crane at the Window and a Gift for the Newlyweds
scenes.summary: Max's crane lift jams outside Vika's window, while at the restaurant Nagiyev publicly presents Kostya and Nastya with the wedding money envelope.

scenes.title: Falling from the Third Floor
scenes.summary: Max calls out to Vika from the crane platform outside her window, teases her for hiding, and accidentally falls from the third floor when the crane jerks.

scenes.title: The Doctor's Exam and Kitchen Rehearsal
scenes.summary: A doctor examines Max at Vika's apartment and finds no fractures, Vika stays home with him, and Chef Barinov rehearses a kitchen sleight-of-hand routine.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Ocean's Eleven
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov and the cooks rehearse distracting Nagiyev's friend in the kitchen to swap the dish, while Vika checks on Max at her apartment.

scenes.title: Buying the Car and the Guest's Condition
scenes.summary: Nastya surprises a stunned Kostya by spending the wedding money on Eva's car, and Nagiyev's friend insists that all the cooks leave the kitchen during the bet.

scenes.title: Plan B and the Cold Oven
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov's backup plan puts a pre-made rabbit in the oven for Nagiyev, but Nagiyev forgets to turn the oven on and serves his friend raw rabbit.

scenes.title: Kostya's Deception Exposed
scenes.summary: Kostya tells Nastya's father that Nastya bought a car with the wedding money, and when Nastya discovers her father paid for everything, she calls off the wedding.

scenes.title: Vika's Farewell
scenes.summary: After a late-night phone call from Katya ruins their reconciliation, Vika tells Max she has accepted a job abroad and is leaving.
